adjudication_summary: Worker-4/worker-6 re-review reopened the packet manifest, XML/PDF text, OA figure assets, supplementary PDF, and linked APD6/DBAASP rows. Source-supported activity, toxicity, mechanism, and database rows were repaired; unresolved blocking tickets are closed. The final state is publication-grade with explicit database/source cautions, not clean acceptance.

materials_exhausted.note: Local material was sufficient for worker-4 and worker-6 closeout. The supplementary PDF contained methods, primers, expression/HPLC/MS/mycoplasma figures and did not alter Table 2 activity, Figure 7 biofilm, Figure 8 toxicity/hemolysis, or database identity adjudication.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: APD6/DBAASP sequence identities were checked against source Methods 4.2/Figure 1A plus merged sequence rows. Spa31 DBAASP activity/cytotoxicity/hemolysis/biofilm rows are source-supported; Spa20/Spa22/Spa14 database endpoint labels and DBAASP Spa14 residue range remain preserved source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity rows were rebuilt from source Table 2 so CGMCC identifiers are no longer treated as activity values; Spa20/Spa22/Spa14 are recorded as MBC/MFC values. Figure 7 biofilm and Figure 8 cytotoxicity/hemolysis rows were added with source locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims now cite direct membrane, LPS interaction, ATP/ROS, biofilm, and zebrafish source locators without overgeneralizing the Spa31 mechanism to the shorter fragments.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review_layer: The original rwk-complete-test-0001 blocker is closed by source-reviewed artifact repair and strict gate reruns; acceptance is with cautions due preserved database/source conflicts.

caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6 and DBAASP rows label Spa20/Spa22/Spa14 antimicrobial values as MIC, while source Table 2 places those fragment values under MBC/MFC columns. Final activity records preserve the source endpoint; database rows remain source_conflict rather than source_verified.

DBAASP labels DBAASPS_20544 as Spampcin (65-76), Spa14, but the source XML/Figure 1A and database sequence support Spa14 as Spampcin65-78 with a 14-aa sequence. The sequence itself matches source, so this is preserved as a name/range conflict.

Table 2 spells the yeast target as Crytococcus neoformans, while methods and linked database rows use Cryptococcus neoformans with the same CGMCC 2.1563 identifier. Final records normalize the species spelling and preserve the table locator.
